config._comment: DC-bias benchmark simulator configuration. Every leaf parameter has value, units, source_doi and verification in {fulltext, datasheet, derived, abstract, assumed, swept-assumption, design}. 'design' = a simulation-design choice, not a physical claim. Departures from the plain textbook model are listed in _design_notes.
_design_notes: The ID set is a two-stratum mixture: half of each unit's states have T_hs in a base stratum [298, 365) K and half in a foldback stratum [365, 400] K, so the driver ceiling binds where the equivalence is tested. OOD-T is (400, 415] K, still on the derating slope (f_min is reached at 416.3 K).
led.kappa_tilde is the dimensionless kappa * I_rated; monotonicity of the LED transfer curve requires 2 * kappa_tilde < 1.
sweeps.led.kappa_tilde tops out at 0.42, not 0.45: with the 15 % unit spread, 0.45 gives units with kappa_tilde > 0.5, which the monotonicity check rejects.
The oracle bias is refined by +/-10 points at 0.05 % steps, so the refinement covers the whole coarse cell on either side of the coarse argmin.
Self-heating is solved in closed form: P_diss is affine in Tj, so the fixed point is exact. Non-existence (1 - Rth * dP/dTj <= 0, thermal runaway) raises.

Baseline B2 (Zhang and Zhang 2014) is the midpoint of the clipping window [0, C_hat], the exact optimum of that paper's stated MSE objective. Table I of that paper is not reproducible (see dcbias/zhang_check.py). B2 therefore coincides with B3.
R_label is 512: the common-random-numbers gate failed at 256 (RMS within-state label SD above 0.003 I_rated).

BER uses the exact Gray square-QAM formula derived from the decision regions of the implemented bit map. A nearest-neighbour approximation under-read counted bits by up to 0.09 decade at BER >= 1e-2 and failed the counted-bit gate (94.8 % < 95 %).
Oracle and label curves are interpolated with PCHIP, not linearly: linear interpolation failed the 0.002-decade interpolation gate (max 0.0047).
Label L2 uses the HD-FEC threshold 4.5e-3 (Chang 2010, Table 1); 3.8e-3 is kept as a sensitivity column (L2_38).

The LED lower clip is i_min = 0.10 I_rated (Tsonev 2013, Table I; normalising by I_rated is derived) at every clip site, in the bias grid and in the probe. It is swept over {0, 0.05}; the Tsonev cubic is a sensitivity row (led.model).

Tj_Rth_hat carries (lambda_T - 1) * u_ntc_offset without noise at lambda_T > 1; it is kept, with a with/without-Tj_Rth_hat ablation in results_sensing.json. L2_38 is reported in results_main.json. The B7 selection score is reported with its row count and unit-bootstrap SE; the C1 comparator is whichever non-ML candidate wins selection, as coded.
States whose junction temperature at the L1 bias exceeds led.Tj_max_K get tj_ok = false and are excluded from evaluation; their share is reported in provenance.

Tj_Rth_hat uses an estimated dissipated power (measured P_elec minus nominal optical power at the NTC temperature), not the true P_diss. The forward-voltage Tj method assumes a per-unit calibrated K-factor whose residual is epsK, so no K_V spread term is added.
C2 is an intersection-union test (all three OOD CI lower bounds > 0) with no multiplicity adjustment.

SNR_ref is the linear-LED reference SNR (receiver noise = (eta0 sigma_I)^2 / SNR_ref). OOD-SNR is defined on SNR_ref, an input fixed before simulation. Realised SINR at b_p and at L1 is reported per row because the link is distortion-limited.
B6b tables include the M axis for both labels and use 24 T points over the 298-415 K span. B6a for L1 stays 4-D (M omitted); discrete LUT columns such as M get one cell per value.

R_label.note: raised from 256 to 512 because the common-random-numbers gate failed at 256 (RMS within-state label SD 0.00307 I_rated > 0.003; mean regret 0.0002 decades passed)

quad_nodes.note: uniform-node Gaussian quadrature on [-span, span]; accuracy checked in tests

eta0_nom.note: radiant efficiency scale; enters only self-heating and the noise reference

kappa_tilde.note: Tsonev 2013 Table I OSRAM cubic -> 0.36; Cree XP-G3 rel. flux vs I -> 0.27

delta.note: Cree XP-G3 110% (25 C) -> 87% (150 C); Lumileds Rebel ES 0.0019/K

model.note: quadratic (nominal) or tsonev_cubic (sensitivity row); the cubic is scaled to the quadratic's small-signal slope at I_rated/2 and the unit kappa_tilde spread does not apply to it

i_min_frac.note: Tsonev 2013 Table I: p(i) on [0.1, 1] A, constant outside (= current clipped at 0.1 A); minimum DCO bias 0.19 A, p. 3073. Normalising by I_rated is derived

tsonev_cubic.units: W vs A, highest power first
tsonev_cubic.note: Tsonev 2013 Table I OSRAM OSTAR on [0.1, 1] A; evaluated at i / I_rated

Tj_max_K.note: 150 C maximum junction temperature as listed in the Cree XP-G3 and Lumileds Rebel ES datasheets (value not independently re-checked). Inert by design (max Tj at L1 about 417 K): provenance reports tj_margin_min_K_by_split, so it is not an active safety screen.

Rth.note: junction-to-pad: XP-G3 1.1, XP-E2 5.8, Rebel ES 6, Rebel 10

unit_spread._comment: Latent per-unit parameters: value * U[1 - w, 1 + w] unless a range is given. Drawn once per unit, never observed.

ntc_offset_sd.note: thermistor tolerance; shifts the driver's own foldback reading

epsK_sd.note: per-unit K-factor calibration error of the forward-voltage Tj method

knee_K.note: board NTC: Allegro AN296297 80/85 C; TI SNIA037 100/115 C

rho.note: Komine 2004 IV: signal 1e4-1e5 vs ambient 1e7-1e8 photons/bit

T_hs_K.note: overall span: base stratum, foldback stratum, OOD-T

SNR_ref_dB.note: linear-LED reference SNR: AC electrical SNR at b = I_rated/2, T0, no clipping, kappa = 0

probe_frac.note: current operating bias b_p, independent of the state; capped at 0.9 I_max

stratum_T_hs_K.note: foldback-active stratum (the ceiling binds in 52-65 % of its states); the base stratum is [states.T_hs_K[0], 365)

stratum_share.note: odd-indexed states of every non-OOD-T unit are in the foldback stratum

sigma_P_rel.note: electrical-power measurement error (driver V and I sense) in the Rth-model Tj estimate

k_grid.note: Armstrong 2008 eq. 3: 7 dB -> k=2, 13 dB -> k=4.36; Dissanayake 2013 10 dB -> k=3

margin_decades.note: equivalence margin, fixed before any result was seen

sweeps._comment: One factor at a time from nominal; each on 50 units x 100 states; run by dcbias/sweeps.py. _joint: mandatory joint controls. _design: design overrides for every sweep run. 'stress' values lie outside every source.
